chapter: Eddie Heywood, the organ and later work
title: The Shalimar and Minton's
summary: He led groups with Rudy Rutherford and Ronnie Coles at the Shalimar uptown and played Minton's.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: How long were you at the Shalimar uptown?
Oh boy, that's another one. We can't forget the Shalimar! Oh, on and off, about a month at a time. I had a group there with Rudy Rutherford, Ronnie Coles and (?) Richardson.
Also in Minton's Playhouse, I had Kista(?) Major, a flute player and alto...
